dumb_delay_minutes.label: Simple waitlist
dumb_delay_minutes.helper: A member has X minutes to book before they lose their priority spot on the waitlist.

smart_delay_percentage.label: Intelligent waitlist
smart_delay_percentage.helper: A member has X minutes, which equals a Y percentage of the remaining time, before the session begins to complete the booking.

auto_consume_pack.helper: A member that joined the waitlist will be automatically booked in once a spot becomes available. The system will automatically deduct the credits from passes that expire the soonest.
auto_consume_pack.label: Automatically book in a member from the waitlist once a spot becomes available and the deduct the credit(s) from a valid pass

kick_if_no_pack_when_auto_consume.helper: A member might use his credits on another session while waiting on the waiting list. With this settings activated, if that happens, his slot on waiting list will be automatcially cancelled when it is his turn to register.
kick_if_no_pack_when_auto_consume.label: Automatically remove the member from the waiting list if, when his slots becomes available, he does not have a valid pass anymore

is_option_blocking.helper: A spot will be saved for members that joined the waitlist until they book.
is_option_blocking.label: Save openings exclusively for members that joined the waitlist

autokick_delay.helper: This is the number of notifications a member on a waitlist will receive before they're automatically removed if no response is registered.
autokick_delay.label: Automatic waitlist removal

0.explain: Each member that joins the waitlist will be ranked. The first person will be notified automatically once a spot becomes available.
0.label: One by one
0.overallExplainSmart: If a spot becomes available, the student has {{ autokick_delay }} reminders spaced at {{ smart_delay_percentage }}% of the time remaining before the session starts to register. For example, if there are {{ example_hours_before }} hours left before the session, the student has {{ example_computed_delay_one }} minutes to register, and then {{ example_computed_delay_two }} minutes after the first retry, and so on, before the next student is allowed to register.
0.overallExplainSimple: If a spot becomes available, the student has {{ autokick_delay }} reminders spaced {{ dumb_delay_minutes }} minutes apart to book before giving their spot to the next student.

1.explain: This is an unsorted and unranked waitlist. All members that joined this waitlist will be informed simultaneously once a spot becomes available.
1.label: First come, first served

last_delay_before_auto_consume.label: Do not accept bookings automatically if a session takes place in less than
last_delay_before_auto_consume.helper: If the session takes place too soon in the future, the member will not be booked in even if they have a valid pass

check_credit.helper: A client will not be able to be added to a waiting list unless he has a pass compatible with the session, and with enough credit
check_credit.label: Ensure the customer has one valid pass compatible with the session, with enough credit

display_member_position.label: Display the position in the waiting list

errors.dumbDelayMinutesError: Minutes between recalls should be higher than 15
errors.smartDelayPercentageError: The percentage needs to be between 10 and 100

explainWaitingListConf: Example: a member that joined the waitlist for a session that starts in 3 hours has {{nbMinutesBeforeBookingOptionExpire}} minute(s) to complete their booking before they lose their priority spot on the waitlist.

delete.title: Remove from waitlist
delete.content: Are you sure that you want to remove this member from the waitlist? The member will also be notified of this.
delete.sendEmail: Send a message of the removal
delete.contentV2: Are you sure you want to remove this member from the waitlist?

error.title: The auto booking has failed
error.content: Members could not be added to the session. Please try again

success.title: Members were added to the session successfully

info.title: Automatic bookings for valid passes
info.content: Members with valid passes will be automatically booked into the session and will receive a confirmation email. The system will automatically deduct the credits from passes that expire the soonest

loading.title: Members are being added to the session
loading.content: Please do not refresh the tab or leave this page. This process can take a few seconds to run.

warning.title: Are you sure?
warning.content: By closing the form, the selected member(s) will not be added to the session. If you selected several members and want to unselect this member only, please click on cancel on the member form

content.registered: The following members have been registered, as a compatible pass was found:
content.unregistered: The following members could NOT be registered, no compatible pass could be found

member.empty: There are no waitlists to display.
